cases.description: The customer's email and phone number must be redacted before this record leaves this context.
cases.grounding: engine report: pii=['email-address', 'phone-number']; content_redacted replaces both with '<redacted>'.

cases.description: If the downstream action doesn't actually need the customer's contact details, only the minimal necessary fields (e.g. name) should be carried forward — not the full record.
cases.grounding: content contains name + email + phone; the stated action ('read a file to check its current contents') gives no indication all three fields are needed.
cases.assumptions: Assuming the downstream use doesn't require contacting the customer directly — not stated either way.

cases.description: Sensitivity is medium — PII (email, phone) was found in the content, with no secret-shaped match.
